trends.name: Iran Energy Infrastructure Standoff
trends.summary: Trump extended pause on attacking Iranian energy facilities to April 6, with markets uncertain on long-term resolution. Multiple sources confirm there is no viable military option to re-open Strait of Hormuz if infrastructure is struck, creating a geopolitical stalemate with massive oil supply implications. A 56% probability of US-Iran ceasefire by May 31 per Polymarket suggests market expects negotiated settlement, but crude volatility will persist through April.

trends.name: Big Tech AI Infrastructure Crunch
trends.summary: Nuclear power capacity bottleneck emerging as critical constraint on AI expansion—no fuel availability, no welders, and no Plan B for data center power demands. Meta's $10B West Texas investment signals companies are pivoting to alternative solutions, but structural supply-side challenges could limit AI capex growth and profitability timelines for Magnificent Seven stocks.

trends.name: Nasdaq 100 Correction & Valuation Reset
trends.summary: Nasdaq 100 has traded below all-time highs for 100 consecutive days while remaining <10% from peak—6th time since 1985 this pattern occurred. Previous 5 instances preceded significant downside. Concentration risk in NVDA/MSFT at extreme valuations (30x+ sales) flagged as potential historic bubble, with Goldman's panic index at 9.14/10 signaling institutional capitulation and repositioning.

trends.name: Pension Fund Equity Rotation Underway
trends.summary: US pension funds estimated to purchase $13.8B in equities by quarter-end—the largest monthly purchase since 97% of comparable periods over 3 years and 93% since 2000. This institutional rotation signals potential bottom formation and could provide technical support to markets despite geopolitical headwinds and tech valuation concerns.

trends.name: Private Credit Market Stress & Redemptions
trends.summary: Individual investors fleeing private credit funds while institutional capital entering at slower pace, creating structural imbalance in the $2T+ private credit market. Wall Street banks see this as opportunity to reclaim turf from alternative asset managers, but fund flows remain fragile amid valuation questions and liquidity concerns.

trends.name: China Industrial Profit Surge & Oil Shock
trends.summary: China's industrial profits surged 15% to start 2026, outpacing expectations and signaling strong manufacturing momentum. However, oil price volatility and potential Iran energy disruptions threaten margin expansion outlook. India's new export tax on refineries adds additional pressure to energy complex and emerging market currencies.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO & Mega-Cap Equity Debut
trends.summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX preparing for record-breaking IPO that could be largest equity debut ever, adding significant new liquidity to markets and creating new mega-cap allocation dynamics. Timing amid tech volatility and Musk's involvement in political/regulatory issues creates binary execution risk for underwriters and investors.

trends.name: Japan Yen Intervention & 20Y Bond Spike
trends.summary: Japan's 20-year government bond yield jumped 6bps to 3.180%, while finance minister flagged possibility of 'bold actions' on currency—code for yen intervention. BOJ policy tightening and rising JGB yields signal shift in Japanese monetary stance, with potential contagion to global bond markets and carry trade unwind risks.

trends.name: SMIC Chip Export to Iran Military
trends.summary: Trump administration officials revealed China's largest chipmaker SMIC sent chipmaking tools to Iran's military, escalating US-China tech decoupling tensions and raising questions about Beijing's geopolitical alignment. This could trigger new semiconductor export controls and further fragment global chip supply chains.

trends.name: US Military Escalation in Middle East
trends.summary: US considering deployment of up to 10,000 additional ground troops to Middle East to provide Trump 'more military options,' escalating regional presence beyond 5,000 Marines and 82nd Airborne paratroopers. Military buildup increases tail risk of Iran conflict re-ignition despite diplomatic pause, creating elevated geopolitical premium in energy and defense equities.

trends.name: Future PLC Steep Downgrade & Retail Crisis
trends.summary: Jefferies downgraded Future PLC to Hold from Buy with target price slashed 62% from 1,220p to 466p, signaling deeper structural challenges in UK retail. Broader retail sector facing margin pressure from labor costs, consumer spending slowdown, and inventory risks across discretionary categories.

trends.name: Federal Reserve Leadership Concerns & Rate Policy
trends.summary: Sen. Elizabeth Warren strongly criticized Federal Reserve chair pick Kevin Warsh, citing 'learned nothing from failures'—signaling potential confirmation battle and uncertainty around future rate policy direction. Debate over Fed leadership during period of elevated inflation, geopolitical uncertainty, and market fragility could impact rate-cut expectations and duration risk.
